summary: Phase 6 (EPIC 3.5 Arus Kas & Penagihan + EPIC M5 Laporan & BI Finance) end-to-end testing completed successfully. All backend APIs (116/116 tests) and frontend UI features passed. Validated cashflow projection (monthly/weekly), collections worklist with remind/late-fee actions, multi-report system with PDF/CSV export, and collection config updates. All regression tests (Dashboard, AR, AP, Komisi, Beranda) passed without errors.
